courses.overview: 由潤濕、熱曲線與焊點形成延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend wetting, thermal profiles and joint formation into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 表面黏著生產線
related.why: 回焊和選焊都接續組装資料與材料追溯。
related.whyEn: Reflow/selective soldering both depend on assembly data/material traceability.
related.transfer: 回焊和選焊都接續組装資料與材料追溯。
related.transferEn: Reflow/selective soldering both depend on assembly data/material traceability.
related.difference: 選焊有噴嘴可達性與通孔填充，回焊以全板熱曲線為核心。
related.differenceEn: Selective soldering adds nozzle access/hole fill; reflow centers on whole-board profiles.
practice: 把「合金與液相」的概念圖與「表面黏著生產線」的輸入輸出對照。
比較重元件與薄焊墊的溫升斜率。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：選焊有噴嘴可達性與通孔填充，回焊以全板熱曲線為核心。
practiceEn: Compare the alloy and liquidus concept map with inputs/outputs of Surface-mount production lines.
Compare temperature-rise slopes of heavy components and thin pads.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Selective soldering adds nozzle access/hole fill; reflow centers on whole-board profiles.

related.title: 汽車電子環境耐久驗證
related.why: 熱歷程形成的界面影響車用長期疲勞。
related.whyEn: Thermally formed interfaces affect automotive fatigue.
related.transfer: 熱歷程形成的界面影響車用長期疲勞。
related.transferEn: Thermally formed interfaces affect automotive fatigue.
related.difference: 外觀一次合格不能代表經環境循環後仍可靠。
related.differenceEn: Initial visual acceptance does not prove post-cycling reliability.
practice: 把「氧化與助焊」的概念圖與「汽車電子環境耐久驗證」的輸入輸出對照。
由實測曲線積出各焊點的停留時間。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：外觀一次合格不能代表經環境循環後仍可靠。
practiceEn: Compare the oxides and flux concept map with inputs/outputs of Automotive-electronics environmental durability validation.
Extract dwell above liquidus from each measured joint profile.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Initial visual acceptance does not prove post-cycling reliability.

courses.summaryEn: Selective soldering and reflow control links components, systems and validation through wetting, thermal profiles and joint formation. The location gives public supply-chain or case geography.
courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，保留本課的基本模型，重新核對材料、規模、環境與驗收邊界。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Kurtz Ersa 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。固相線和液相線與合金有關，不能把所有焊料視為同一熔點。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「潤濕、熱曲線與焊點形成」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Kurtz Ersa provides a traceable starting point. Solidus and liquidus depend on alloy; solders do not share one melting point. Independently authored models connect this to wetting, thermal profiles and joint formation; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：孔壁潤濕、間隙和熱容量共同控制通孔填充。 以「比較相同接觸時間不同熱負載的填孔資料。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: Barrel wetting, gap and thermal mass jointly control through-hole fill. Practice interpretation using: Compare fill at equal contact time with different thermal loads. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
